Scientific Survey - Prince Rupert Harbour
An Uncrewed Surface Vessel (USV) will depart from Cow Bay Marina and transit throughout Prince Rupert harbour to Rushbrook boat launch.
The Kaien Xplorer USV is 3.7m long, red and white in colour and is equipped with AIS. 
Hours of operation from 1700UTC to 1900UTC on 04 November.
Call operators at 250-627-2522 for any questions or concerns.
